title: Q-SAYDO-loops-second-loop-kept: says second-loop-kept, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe loops:second-loop-kept
**Status:** closed

The system states `second-loop-kept` (loops) and its code does not do it: 0 of 14 second-order steps kept in 14 days

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe loops:second-loop-kept` exits 0.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-22T01:33:12Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
